desc: the reserved bytes are counted one more
old: internal void AddReserved(long bytes) => Interlocked.Add(ref _reserved, bytes);
new: internal void AddReserved(long bytes) => Interlocked.Add(ref _reserved, bytes + 1);

desc: the reserved bytes are the explicit writes
a reserved byte is also an explicit write
old: internal void AddReserved(long bytes) => Interlocked.Add(ref _reserved, bytes);
new: internal void AddReserved(long bytes) { Interlocked.Add(ref _reserved, bytes); Interlocked.Add(ref _writeBytes, bytes); }
